visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long straight black hair, wearing a black bucket hat and a black protective face mask, walks down a brightly lit indoor corridor. She is dressed in a grey t-shirt and carries a black shoulder bag. She gazes directly into the camera while walking. (2) Inside a metallic elevator, the woman talks to the camera, her eyes wide and expressive. A second person, a male in a white t-shirt, is partially visible beside her. She gestures naturally with her hands as she speaks. (3) A sequence shows a close-up of a hand using a black pen to fill out a medical registration form on a wooden surface. This is followed by a shot of an Omron blood pressure monitor on a table, displaying a reading of 99/71. (4) The woman is now in a clinical reception area. She flips through a brochure for Down syndrome screening. She is seen giving a thumbs-up gesture while standing near a service counter where staff members are working in the background. (5) A television screen displays a grayscale ultrasound of a fetus. Animated baby graphics (boy and girl) and text stickers are overlaid on the screen. The woman's face is occasionally shown in a small circular picture-in-picture inset as she reacts to the ultrasound. (6) In a final reaction shot, the woman sits indoors, covering her face with her hand in a gesture of playful disappointment. She wears a gold bracelet. The scene eventually fades into a circular black frame transition.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a bright, high-energy electronic synthesizer BGM. A female voice speaks in an excited, rapid-fire Mandarin tone, discussing her baby's gender. The BGM features a steady percussive beat. (2) A sharp digital 'pop' sound effect marks a transition. The female speaker engages in a humorous dialogue with a male speaker whose voice is lower and more relaxed. The BGM continues as a rhythmic bed underneath the conversation. (3) Upon entering the clinic, ambient room tones are subtle. A rhythmic, pulsing Doppler ultrasound sound—the fetus's heartbeat—is heard clearly, accompanied by a digital chime SFX. (4) During the ultrasound reveal, the vocal arousal of both the female speaker and a third female voice (medical staff) increases with laughter and high-pitched exclamations. Meme-style 'boing' and 'sparkle' SFXs are layered over the reveal. (5) The video concludes with the female speaker's mock-sad sigh and a final comedic 'slide' sound effect as the music fades out, leaving a clean ambient background.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Anticipation -> Examination Process -> Climax (Reveal) -> Emotional Reaction
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a pregnant woman's visit to a clinic for a prenatal check-up and gender reveal. It uses a comedic, vlog-style narrative to share the excitement and eventual playful disappointment when the baby is revealed to be a boy instead of the hoped-for girl.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While brands like Omron and clinical services are shown, they appear as organic parts of the vlog's setting rather than a paid promotional campaign.
